properties.name: Replies fit (PR B): a proof's read-back says each premise's reason once, the hub budgets for what it adds, get_skill and propagate_from take budget_chars, and the door prints what the budget measured
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-22: "Go with your recommendations (for all the open decisions)", which queued PR B after A1 (#790) and A2 (#791). Every item traces to a node: fact:root-cause-a-reasoning-read-back-outgrows-the-client-on-repeated-premise-prose-and-text-added-after-the-budget-2026-10-22 (items 1 and 2; flo2's persona block and per-design door are flo2's half), fact:root-cause-get-skill-attaches-every-lesson-unbounded-so-six-skills-outgrow-a-chat-reply-on-reflow2s-design-2026-10-21 (item 3, the fix the fact proposed), the rocket-equation rung's finding (b) (item 4, reproduced first on the heat fixture), and fact:the-call-door-and-the-duplicated-text-block-print-pretty-json-over-the-budget-the-reply-was-held-to-2026-10-23 (item 5; the '47%' measurement from #788 was not found as a node, so it was reproduced and recorded). One judgement: a premise row keeps its `why` field, holding the short reading, rather than a new `reads` field with `why` removed, because a reply field is removed only after a release of notice (deprecation.rs). The guard against recurrence: replies_are_bounded.py now asks get_skill root-cause and propagate_from both whole and held, so a default that stops holding fails CI; the hub test failed on the code before the fix (17,352 against 16,562). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: PR B of the queue (branch feat/replies-fit). (1) reasoning_report: a premise row's `why` holds its reason's leading clause; the full reason is said once per page in `premise_whys` (or in the premise's own claim row on the page); the unverified-citation and undocumented-report advisories are said once in `advisories` with the ids they apply to. Heat rung fixture: the whole walk 133,198 -> 114,072 characters, premise-row reasons 23,332 -> 5,226 plus 1,492 cited once, the advisory 46 times -> once; a 60,000 page holds 20 whole claims, not 18. (2) Through a hub's address a read that takes budget_chars is held with the hub's prefixes and view_note counted: over budget, the design is asked again at the budget lowered by the overshoot, and the view_note says so; a write is never asked twice. (3) get_skill takes budget_chars (default 30,000): body whole, lessons newest first withheld whole from the end and named by id; root-cause on reflow2's design 54,029 -> 29,147, and the other five that outgrew 29,267 now fit. (4) propagate_from takes budget_chars (default 30,000): rows withheld whole from the end of inferences, impacted, direct_ring, risk_crossings and across_designs, each named by id, counts kept; 41,073 -> 28,974 on the heat fixture at max_depth 2. (5) --call, --describe and the duplicate content policy's text block are compact JSON: held to 30,000, the door printed 35,087 before and 29,977 now. Toolsnap: get_skill and propagate_from gain budget_chars. No node or edge type, property or enum changed: the stamp does not move.
